mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 82 degrees with partly cloudy skies out at Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to use the new tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center for free, scenic rides on the Military Ridge State Trail, or look into seasonal job openings with the Recreation Department.
We have plenty of fun ahead with trivia today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by tomorrow's downtown farmer's market and more trivia at the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly report, on July 31, an officer conducted a stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for an O W I.
Enjoy the Butter Pecan flavor of the day today at Culver's, and be sure to stop by before they close for the evening at 10:00 PM.
